cell_line: For each of the four control cell lines (negative: RKO, CC07; positive: HT55, CaCo-2), we grew one T‐175 flask under standard culture conditions in culture medium to ~70% confluency, washed the cells once with 10 ml ice-cold PBS and subsequently scraped them into 2 ml 4% PFA in PBS, following centrifugation at 400 x g for 10 min and fixation overnight.
